title: pvCriticalTime
body:
## pvCriticalTime

Scans every time step of a temporal input and records, for each point or cell, the first time value at which the selected array meets a threshold criterion (above, below or between thresholds; comparisons include the threshold values). The result is a static (non-temporal) dataset with one array named <array>_critical_time; other point and cell arrays are dropped, and entries whose criterion is never met are NaN. Use it for arrival or exceedance maps, e.g. when temperature first exceeds a limit. The mesh must keep the same points and cells over time.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The filter executes the whole upstream pipeline for every stored time step, which can be slow for long series.
- With the ParaView defaults (Above Upper Threshold, UpperThreshold 0) any non-negative value counts as met, so most entries become the first time; always set the threshold.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CriticalTime`. Identity: `filters/CriticalTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the **Critical Time** filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComponentMode` | This property specifies how multi-component arrays are handled. 'Selected' will use the 'Selected Component' property. 'All' will pass if all components satisfy the threshold criterion. 'Any' will pass if any component satisfies the threshold criterion. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Selected","All","Any"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Selected"` |
| `LowerThreshold` | This value specifies the lower threshold. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Scalars` | The value of this property contains the name of the array from which to generate the critical time values. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectedComponent` | This property specifies which component of the array needs to satisfy the threshold criterion. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ThresholdCriterion` | This property indicates the threshold criterion used to generate the critical time values. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Between","Below Lower Threshold","Above Upper Threshold"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Between"` |
| `UpperThreshold` | This value specifies the upper threshold. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
